title.narrative: ACE Africa (UK) Institutional assessment and strengthening

description.narrative: ACE Africa (UK) was registered as a UK Charity in September 2005, following the establishment of local partners ACE Africa (Kenya) in 2003 and later ACE Africa (TZ) in 2007 and exists to provide them with fundraising and technical support aiming to increase organisational autonomy in Africa through institutional strengthening and staff and strategic development. ACE Africa (UK) values effective use of funds keeping UK costs to a minimum, employing one full time Director, an administrator and part time accountant in the UK. ACE Africa (UK) engages two volunteers and employs the Founder (technical support) in Africa. Given its youth and small size in relation to ACE in Africa, ACE Africa (UK) seeks funding for an independent institutional assessment to better enable it to prioritise organisational needs and maximise human and financial resources for the benefit of the entire organisation. Institutional strengthening will support ACE Africa (UK)'s need to increase funding sources for operations in Africa, strengthen governance and staff skills and improve communications, marketing strategies and fundraising opportunities. This in turn will increase opportunities for advocacy and lobbying at the international level supporting the organisational aim of sharing the programming approach with partner organisations in SSA.
